changes: Preserve one original same-version unseen proof when the latest material attempt is independently verified and successful.
Keep the original record ID and submission date; successful seen review does not create a new-material proof or extend the 48-hour interval.
Latest failed, pending, interrupted, assisted, correction, unresolved or mismatched-version evidence still blocks the material.

validation.method: Actual course materials with synthetic answers, reviews, audio-proof fixtures and isolated in-memory storage; no family submissions or live browser were used.
checks: Default cumulative day 1–7 natural-date history reaches actual day 8 vocabulary without injected week access.
Default cumulative day 2–10 progression chooses the next course.
Homepage DOM primary button routes from day 7 to w02-read-1-vocabulary.
All-submitted pending reviews stay pending and never auto-pass.
End/resume preserves the shared 360-minute study-plus-rest budget and draft identity.
Reviewed curriculum v4 preserves old completed records and exact bound drafts; next-date DOM resume retains old answers and bindings.
Latest incorrect/pending/assisted/interrupted/correction/unresolved/version/exposure mismatch does not borrow old success.
Same-day acceleration and seen-only attempts do not invent 48-hour retention; existing gate A/B requirements remain unchanged.
Old v1 bound history and the exact 25 registered mixed v1-to-v2 seen reviews retain original proof IDs and dates against the newly published v2 dataset.
All 25 complete material and frozen semantic-contract hashes were independently recomputed; unknown 999, rehashed changed answers/level, absent registry and changed current material are rejected.

The public builder reads and validates the separate static JSON registry, preserving ordinary compatibility entries. Its pure registration function was tested; no Git collector or full repository rebuild was run.

limitations: Independent readiness is deliberately not granted for an all-seen or assisted first week, or for completing seven courses in one day.
Cross-version retention is limited to the exact 25 reviewed revisions registered by old/new complete material hashes and semantic-contract hashes. Unknown or modified versions remain rejected.
This fix does not implement a new alternative validation curriculum or change progression policy.
unchanged: Core curriculum data, Player, Daily Load, gate thresholds, storage schemas, user records and frozen contextual-vocabulary candidates remain unchanged. The separate static public revision registry and its generator admission are new.
